# Pong

First to 5. You are the left paddle. The machine is the right one, a little late and a little short, which is the whole game.

## Start

Return leaves the title. R starts the match again and skips the title.

## The paddle

W and S, or the up and down arrows, move your paddle. Each clean hit speeds the ball up. Miss, and the other side scores.

The score sits on the table, 🙂 and 🤖. A small beep marks a hit.
